seoTitle: X (Twitter) Character Counter with Link Weighting
metaDescription: Count a post the way X does: links count 23, emoji and CJK count double, limit 280. Free and private, nothing is sent.
intro: Count a post the way X does: links count as 23, emoji and CJK count as 2, and the limit is 280 weighted characters.
why:
X does not count characters one by one. Every link counts 23 whatever its length, and emoji and many non-Latin characters count double. A post that looks short can be over the limit.

This counter applies the published weighting (the twitter-text configuration, version 3: Latin ranges weigh 1, other characters 2, links 23, limit 280) and shows the plain count next to it. You can change the limit for accounts with a longer allowance. The text stays in your browser.
howTo: Read the weighted length and what remains.
Change the limit if your account allows longer posts.
Shorten the text until the remaining number is zero or more.

faq.a: X shortens every link and counts it as 23 characters, whatever the real length.

faq.q: Why do emoji and Japanese count double?
faq.a: X gives characters outside certain Latin and punctuation ranges a weight of 2, so only 140 of them fit.
Only http(s):// and www. links are detected here. X may also link bare domains, so leave a little room.
